$comment: Performance budget and rules for Byte Bistro. Enforced by `npm run check:perf` (code rules + assets, before every build), scripts/perf/check-bundle-budget.mjs (after every build) and `npm run perf:bench` (browser benchmark). Raise a limit only with a measurement and a reason in the commit; see docs/PERFORMANCE_ARCHITECTURE.md.

bundle.$comment: Measured 2026-10-15: main chunk 7,359 kB min / 1,552 kB gzip (all of Babylon via the barrel import; see PERFORMANCE_AUDIT.md P1). The limit is a ratchet just above today's size: it stops growth now and should be lowered when deep imports land.

assets.$comment: Applies to every model the game loads (the file actually served: the optimized copy when there is one).

exceptions.Anim/Animations/gltf/Rig_Medium/Rig_Medi: Clip pack: meshopt would split its shared skin (see asset-pipeline.json); 0.84 MB, background priority.
exceptions.src/assets/ingredients/ram_module.glb: Joining its 82 instanced parts makes the file 25% larger; kept as authored.
exceptions.src/assets/ingredients/ram_module_item.g: Same as ram_module.glb: joining instanced parts grows it 89%.

runtime.$comment: Checked by `npm run perf:bench` during a running shift of the official level. Ratchets set 2026-10-15 from measurements (before -> after): draw calls 1833 -> 326, active meshes 2227 -> 866, scene meshes 2718 -> 2443, preview textures 134.6 -> 37.6 MB, heap growth over 3 rebuilds 1.6 MB. Counts are hardware-independent; frame times depend on the machine and only fail past the ceiling.

network.$comment: Cold cache, throttled (perf:bench --mbps 20 --rtt 40). Measured 2026-10-15 (before -> after): before menu 18.86 -> 7.84 MB, until match prepared 25.74 -> 13.07 MB, menu ready 14.5 -> 4.8-5.9 s; warm reload 0 MB of geometry from the network.

codeRules.$comment: Static rules (scripts/perf/check-perf-rules.mjs). A line may opt out with `// perf-allow: <reason>`; every opt-out is listed in the report.

assetLoaderAllow.src/core/AudioManager.ts: Lazy facade for recorded sound cues, loaded by Babylon's audio engine on first play. No cue is registered today (every effect is synthesized by SynthSfx); a recorded cue added later must stay small and be listed in the audit.

offscreenEngines.src/editor/CatalogThumbnails.ts: Renders 192x144 editor thumbnails on demand into an offscreen canvas; never on screen during play.

qualityExemptEffects.src/scenes/EditorScene.ts: HighlightLayer is the editor's selection outline, a tool, not decoration.
